name: Ishii Kaoru
source:
An ordinary Biology teacher.
Kaoru is what you would call a good woman, but she's so uninteresting that it's hard to approach her. She really hates the stupid and frivolous men, the group of friends she went out with during her college days was nothing but a pain for her. She has experience studying abroad.

[Translated from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20001018095504/http://www1.odn.ne.jp/d-xx/lineup/gizen/chara.htm]official website[/url].]
